alloy: all u: Unit | miscited[u] implies u in Misnesting
all a: Axiom | (some u: Unit | cites[a, u] and u not in Axiom) implies a in Misnesting

all b: Bug | (some i: Issue | b->i in Name.issue and i in Closed) implies b in OutdatedTracking

all c: Conflict | hidden[c] implies c in Finding

all t: Test | adrift[t] implies t in Finding
all t: Test | (t in Declared and (no g: Tag | t->g in Carry.rel)) implies t in Uncitation
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Extend.rel implies (d1->d2 in Context.rel and (all d3: Document | d2->d3 in Context.rel implies d1->d3 in Context.rel))
all f: Fence, u: Unit | (f in Languaged and f->u in Within.rel) implies u->f in Blocks.rel
doubt: Read as universal over every language-naming fence and the unit in whose own text it lies, since uniqueness of that unit is not asserted here.

alloy: all f1: Fence | f1 not in Languaged implies (no u: Unit | u->f1 in Blocks.rel)
no Runner implies (all u: Unit | u not in Untesting)
no Tracker implies (all u: Unit | u not in Untracking)

all r: Run | ((some f1: Frontmatter, mp1: Missing | lists[f1, mp1]) or (some d: Document | d in Unreadable) or (some c: Command | r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) or (some p: Plugin | r->p in Return.code2)) implies r in Exits2
doubt: Took the first two disjuncts literally as unconditional on the run itself, matching the English which never ties them to it.

alloy: all f: Foreign | f in Refused
all f: Unclosed | f in Refused
all f: Unterminated | f in Refused
all f: Frontmatter | (some mp: Missing | lists[f, mp]) implies (all r: Run | r in Exits2)
doubt: Read "every run" as every run whatsoever, not just one tied to the mentioned frontmatter.

alloy: all r: Run, c: Command | (r->c in Ask.rel and not available[c]) implies (c in Unknown and r in Exits2)
all r: Run, c1: Command | (r->c1 in Ask.rel and not available[c1]) implies c1 in Unknown
all d1, d2: Document | d1->d2 in Bare.rel implies (d1 in Finding iff d2 in Finding)

some d: Document, a: Axiom, s: Spec, i: Index, t: Test, g: Tag | no Finding and d->a in Hold.units and d->s in Hold.units and d->i in Hold.indexes and i->d in Match.rel and s->a in Sit.rel and t in Declared and t->g in Carry.rel and g->s in Name.tag
doubt: Took "holds ... an index" as Hold.indexes (distinct from Hold.units for the axiom and spec), with "matches the document" as a separate Match.rel fact about that same index.

alloy: some bug_1: Bug, expected_failure_1: ExpectedFailure, issue_1: Issue | bug_1->issue_1 in Name.issue and issue_1 in Known and issue_1 not in Closed and checks[expected_failure_1, bug_1] and bug_1 not in Finding and expected_failure_1 not in Finding
all u: Unit | (u in Generated and u not in Differs and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Current
doubt: "would say exactly the same" read as the statement not differing from what the formula says (not Differs).

alloy: all u: Unit | (u in Logical and u in Stated and u not in Generated and u not in Unsayable) implies u in Handwritten
all u: Unit | (u in Wordless or u in Twofold) implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Wordless implies u in Unsayable
all u: Unit | u in Current implies u not in Reported
doubt: "it" read as the unit itself, matching Reported's argument.

alloy: all r: Run | (r->CheckCommand in Ask.rel and (some u: Unit | u in Reported)) implies r not in Exits0
all r: Run, gc: GenerateCommand, u: Unit | (r->gc in Ask.rel and u in Handwritten) implies (u in Reported and r not in Exits0)
all w: Word | (w in Undeclared or w in Misplaced or w in Apart or w in Unused) implies w in Flagged
all d: Document, d2: Document, u: Unit | (d not in Checked and d->u in Hold.units and d2 in Checked and d->d2 in Context.rel) implies u not in Rewritten
doubt: "When it generates, checker does not write..." folded into not Rewritten, since that reading already says "when it generates" on both its positive and negative sides.

alloy: all document_1, document_2: Document, unit_1, unit_2: Unit, word_1: Word | (document_1->document_2 in Context.rel and document_1->unit_1 in Hold.units and unit_1->word_1 in Voice.rel and document_2->unit_2 in Hold.units and unit_2->word_1 in Introduce.rel) implies word_1 not in Undeclared
all s: Scenario | s in Possible implies s not in Raised
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | (s in Raised and u->s in Frees.rel) implies s->u in Blame.rel
all s: Scenario, u: Unit | s->u in Blame.rel implies u->s in Frees.rel
all unit_1: Unit | unit_1 in Contradicting implies unit_1 in Named
all u: Unit, w: Signature | (u not in Term and loneOn[u, w]) implies u->w in Expose.rel
all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies u in Unchallenged
all u: Unit, w: Word | u->w in Expose.rel implies (u in Logical and u not in Term and w in Signature and loneOn[u, w])
all unit_1, unit_2: Unit, word: Word | (unit_2 != unit_1 and unit_2->word in Utter.rel) implies unit_1->word not in Expose.rel
some u: Unit, w: Signature | u in Logical and u->w in Rely.rel and u->w not in Expose.rel
all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst) implies l in OneLine

all q: Quantifier | q in VariableTwice implies q in InFull
all q: Quantifier | q in NothingToAttach implies q in InFull
all quantifier_1: Quantifier | quantifier_1 in NoWithAnother implies quantifier_1 in InFull
all l: Series | l in RelativeBeforeLast implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in NotClause implies l in AsBullets
all l: Series | l in AndInOr implies l in KeepsAndApart
all l: Series | (l in OneLineRule and l not in TimeFirst and l in TimeSecond) implies l in KeepsThen
some d: Definition | d in OrInsideKind and d in NoKindFirst
some l: Series | l in MoreThanTwo and l in Few and l in CommaItem
some l: Series | l in Few and l in TooLong

always ((all o: Owner, c: Failing | (c->o in on and o in Disposed and runNow[c]) implies always (o not in Threw)) and (all o: Owner, h: Owner, c: Failing | (o->h in handler and c->o in on and o in Disposed and runNow[c]) implies eventually (c->h in reached)))
doubt: "runs on a disposed owner" built from on, Disposed and runNow, since no single word names that combination; the outer "Always" wraps both bulleted rules.

alloy: some o: Owner, h: Owner, c: Failing | o->h in handler and h != o and eventually (dispose[o] and c->o in on and after eventually (runNow[c] and after eventually (c->h in reached)))
doubt: Nested each "at that moment or later" as after eventually from the previous event, to keep the dispose-then-run-then-reached order; "another owner H" kept as h != o even though the handler fact already forces it.
